data.name: Ibrar
data.gender_notes: Ibrar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Ibrar signifies a virtuous or righteous deed. It is derived from the Arabic root that implies doing good or being righteous. The name Ibrar carries the meaning “Virtuous, Righteous Deed” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ibrar usually hope their child will grow to embody virtuous, righteous deed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic context, Ibrar is related to the concept of doing good deeds and being righteous, which is highly valued.
data.etymology: Ibrar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Virtuous, Righteous Deed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ibrar total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_english.name: Ibrar
in_english.meaning: Good reputation and rectification with truthfulness
in_english.long_meaning: Ibrar is an Arabic-derived name that signifies good reputation and rectification with truthfulness. It is one of Allah's beautiful names and is often used to refer to those with a good reputation and truthfulness in their dealings. It is also associated with the concept of rectification and truthfulness in one's life. In Islamic tradition, Ibrar is considered a praiseworthy name and is often bestowed upon children to inculcate good values and moral character.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ibrar has a rich cultural significance for Muslims as it reminds us of the importance of good deeds and virtuous actions in our daily lives. In the life of Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) AS, we find countless examples of righteous behavior, from his unwavering faith, willingness to sacrifice his own son, and standing up against the idol worshippers of his realm. The name encourages us to emulate these actions and strive for righteousness in our own lives, making it a powerful and inspiring name within Islamic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ibrar holds deep significance as it signifies being connected at a fundamental level to the eternal and unchanging values of righteousness and good deeds. As Muslims, we are constantly encouraged to engage in virtuous actions and cultivate our spiritual selves through good works and right intentions. The name Ibrar serves as a constant reminder of this noble pursuit and inspires us to keep moving towards the path of righteousness and closeness to Allah SWT. May AllahSWT give us the ability to live up to the noble meaning and significance of this name. Ameen.
